item.question:
Create a solution at 25 degrees C, pH 7.5, 100 mg/L Ca, and 250 mg/L Alkalinity as CaCO3.

What is the activity of CO2?

A. 3.193e-04
B. 3.199e-04
C. 3.198e-04
D. 3.197e-04

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path":"calc_co2.pqi","new_content":"SOLUTION 1
    temp 25
    pH 7.5
    units mg/L
    Ca 100
    Alkalinity 250 as CaCO3
END
SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
USER_PUNCH
    -headings a_CO2
    10 PUNCH ACT("CO2")
END
"}
